description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering employee work experience search queries within the OrangeHRM HR management system. It extends a base FilterParams class, specifies allowed sorting fields, and includes properties and methods to handle employee number filtering.

classes.name: EmployeeWorkExperienceSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class used for filtering employee work experience search results, including sorting and employee number filters, in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters, setting the default sort field to 'we.jobTitle'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number used as a filter criterion.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter criterion.
